description: This Java class 'FailingInjectorService' extends 'SettingInjectorService' to simulate a service that injects settings and possibly throws an exception based on a configurable flag. It overrides methods to provide a setting summary and enable/disable status, with artificial delay and logging for debugging.

classes.name: FailingInjectorService
classes.description: A service class that extends SettingInjectorService to provide custom setting injection behavior, with simulated failure for testing.

methods.description: Provides a summary string for the setting; includes a simulated delay and optional exception for testing.

methods.description: Returns the enabled state of the setting, fixed to false in this implementation.
